text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Duti Kastam (Langkawi) 2025.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 November 2025.

Duti import

2. Duti import hendaklah dilevi atas dan dibayar oleh pengimport berkenaan

dengan barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual yang diimport masuk

ke dalam Langkawi atau diangkut dari kawasan utama kastam ke Langkawi

pada kadar duti import yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (5) Jadual Pertama kepada

Perintah Duti Kastam 2025 [P.U. (A) 384/2025].

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Duti Kastam (Langkawi) 1986 [P.U. (A) 489/1986] dan

Perintah Duti Kastam (Langkawi) 2020 [P.U. (A) 409/2020] dibatalkan.

CUSTOMS ACT 1967

CUSTOMS DUTIES (LANGKAWI) ORDER 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 163B(1)(a) of the Customs Act 1967

[Act 235] read together with paragraph 163C(b) of the Act, the Minister makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Customs Duties (Langkawi) Order 2025.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 November 2025.

Import duty

2. Import duty shall be levied on and paid by the importer in respect of

the goods specified in the Schedule imported into Langkawi or transported from

the principal customs area to Langkawi at the rate of import duty specified in column (5)

of the First Schedule to the Customs Duties Order 2025 [P.U. (A) 384/2025].

Revocation

3. The Customs Duties (Langkawi) Order 1986 [P.U. (A) 489/1986] and

the Customs Duties (Langkawi) Order 2020 [P.U. (A) 409/2020] are revoked.
